source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football Sleepers: 12 Dark Horse Candidates to Win Your League
source.author: Jim Coventry
source.summary: Twelve players with ADPs beyond pick 100 whose opportunity, scheme, or contingent role can substantially outperform cost.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Addison's touchdown decline tracks poor quarterback play, and Kyler Murray can restore top-24 upside at a WR4 price.
takeaways.rationale: Addison's touchdown decline tracks poor quarterback play, and Kyler Murray can restore top-24 upside at a WR4 price.
risks: Offseason baggage and competition from Minnesota's other targets remain.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Mason has already produced efficiently behind Minnesota's strong line and becomes a major value if the aging Aaron Jones misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Mason has already produced efficiently behind Minnesota's strong line and becomes a major value if the aging Aaron Jones misses time.
risks: His receiving work and standalone volume are minimal when Jones plays.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Kincaid's elite route efficiency and explosive usage create league-winning upside at a TE1/2 border price.
takeaways.rationale: Kincaid's elite route efficiency and explosive usage create league-winning upside at a TE1/2 border price.
risks: PCL trouble, missed games, and possible snap restrictions materially lower the floor.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Tracy offers a stable receiving floor and becomes a lead option if Cam Skattebo misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Tracy offers a stable receiving floor and becomes a lead option if Cam Skattebo misses time.
risks: A healthy Skattebo controls early downs and caps Tracy's standalone ceiling.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Mayfield's pre-injury top-12 pace and scheme continuity make him a cheap quarterback with a proven ceiling.
takeaways.rationale: Mayfield's pre-injury top-12 pace and scheme continuity make him a cheap quarterback with a proven ceiling.
risks: He has played through injuries that materially damaged his production.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Andrews can rebound after Baltimore cleared tight-end competition and recommitted to him in an offense expected to feature the position.
takeaways.rationale: Andrews can rebound after Baltimore cleared tight-end competition and recommitted to him in an offense expected to feature the position.
risks: His 2025 separation and efficiency decline may reflect real aging.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Murray's rushing floor, Kevin O'Connell's system, elite receivers, and improved protection create top-10 upside at a late QB price.
takeaways.rationale: Murray's rushing floor, Kevin O'Connell's system, elite receivers, and improved protection create top-10 upside at a late QB price.
risks: Durability has remained an important concern.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Rodriguez has a clear early-down and goal-line role in an ascending Jacksonville offense with room to gain work if Tuten falters.
takeaways.rationale: Rodriguez has a clear early-down and goal-line role in an ascending Jacksonville offense with room to gain work if Tuten falters.
risks: Six career receptions leave almost no PPR floor.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Stribling's draft capital and ideal Shanahan fit give him a path to early opportunity in an older, injury-prone receiver room.
takeaways.rationale: Stribling's draft capital and ideal Shanahan fit give him a path to early opportunity in an older, injury-prone receiver room.
risks: He remains a rookie stash without a guaranteed starting role.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Nailor's speed, contract, and scheme familiarity give him a legitimate chance to win a large role in Las Vegas.
takeaways.rationale: Nailor's speed, contract, and scheme familiarity give him a legitimate chance to win a large role in Las Vegas.
risks: His NFL production has not yet established starter-level ability.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Flournoy owns a stable third-receiver role in a strong passing offense and becomes immediately useful if either star receiver misses time.
takeaways.rationale: Flournoy owns a stable third-receiver role in a strong passing offense and becomes immediately useful if either star receiver misses time.
risks: His normal role remains behind two high-volume stars.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Hockenson's underlying openness and catch rate can translate into a late-career bounce-back with Kyler Murray restoring passing volume.
takeaways.rationale: Hockenson's underlying openness and catch rate can translate into a late-career bounce-back with Kyler Murray restoring passing volume.
risks: Age and a sharp recent production decline remain meaningful.
